annotation.title_en: Moonshot Goal 3: Realization of AI robots that autonomously learn, adapt to their environment, evolve in intelligence and act alongside human beings, by 2050
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) / Cabinet Office, Government of Japan
annotation.venue: JST Moonshot Research and Development Program website
annotation.summary_en: Japanese government Moonshot R&D programme page for Goal 3, which sets national targets for 2030 and 2050: AI robots that learn on their own and work alongside people. It lists the funded projects on humanoids, care robots, robots for harsh environments, agricultural robots and embodied safety. It is innovation policy expressed as publicly funded R&D targets.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2050, realize AI robots that autonomously learn, adapt and act alongside humans
By 2030, AI robots that behave well with humans under certain conditions so that over 90% of people feel comfortable with them
By 2030, AI robots that operate unattended under human supervision in specific circumstances
Automated AI robot systems for scientific discovery by 2050
Funded projects include general-purpose humanoids, lifelong-care robot AIREC and intrinsically safe embodied mechanisms
